title: 11:16 highway . . . from Assyria. The highway may be an actual road or path for members of the house of Israel to travel on as they return to the land of promise. The fact that "unclean" people, lions, or ravenous beasts (35:8-10; 51:10-11) will not pass over the highway indicates its connection with the straight and narrow path. For this meaning of highway, see 40:3; 42:16; 49:11; 57:14; 62:10.
author: Tina M. Peterson
